subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After years of fights with his neighbour Ram, Shekhar decided to hold out the ______ and invited Ram for tea.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"olive branch"** means an offer of peace or reconciliation. (शांति प्रस्ताव)

 
 
• **Example:** After their argument, she extended an olive branch by apologizing first.
 
 
 
• **"olive branch"** is an appropriate term in the context of resolving conflicts and making peace. (शांति स्थापना)
 
 
• **Example:** The company offered the workers an olive branch to end the strike.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Poker face** (भावशून्य चेहरा): An expressionless face that reveals no emotions.

 
 
• **Example:** She maintained a poker face throughout the meeting, giving away nothing.
 
 
 
• **Comparing apples to oranges** (असमान चीजों की तुलना करना): Comparing two things that are fundamentally different.
 
 
• **Example:** Comparing the two projects is like comparing apples to oranges; they have very different objectives.
 
 
 
• **Chip on shoulder** (नाराजगी): Holding a grudge or feeling of being treated unfairly.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a chip on his shoulder about not being promoted last year.
